feature_name: Custom contract encryption key support for new Apigee hybrid installations
summary: You can now configure a custom contractEncryptionKey when creating new Apigee hybrid installations.
extended_definition: You can now configure a custom contractEncryptionKey when creating new Apigee hybrid installations.
